spots.name: Prowers Bridge
spots.tip: A landmark bridge: try blue hour when the lights come on, or low side light that shows the structure. Mapped as private or no access: check before you go.

spots.name: Twin Buttes
spots.tip: A notable summit. Check the road and trail first; first and last light on high ground is the reason to go, and it's often the subject from below. Summit 1,403 m (4,603 ft).
